title: Allocator · Gate repository-test jobs by declared runtime capability
mission: Close the repeated capability mismatch exposed by dynamic-child-subcompile: jobs whose done gate requires source patching plus repository harness execution must declare that requirement in machine-readable metadata, and allocator compatibility must exclude shells that cannot satisfy it before claim. Reuse the existing capability/compatibility mechanism; do not add a scheduler or a parallel routing layer.
definition_of_done: Repository-test jobs can declare a machine-readable repository_test_runtime requirement before claim.
Allocator compatibility excludes a worker lacking that capability from such a job without treating the project as exhausted.
A control job without repository-test requirements remains compatible.
A deterministic regression covers both cases and preserves existing allocation authority.
forbidden_scope: hardcoding one worker id or one historical failure
treating an incompatible worker as evidence of frontier exhaustion

target.capability: required capability declaration for repository-test jobs
target.owner: portfolio derived job capability metadata and allocator compatibility

semantic_identity.problem: derived jobs that mandate source patching plus repository harness execution can declare no required capabilities and be repeatedly claimed by shells without repository test runtime
acceptance: allocator compatibility excludes shells that cannot satisfy the declared capability before claim
deterministic regression covers one repository-test job and one control job
existing jobs without repository test requirements remain compatible
jobs whose definition of done requires repository checkout or harness execution declare a machine-readable repository test runtime capability

truth_boundary: This job tightens compatibility admission for an existing job class; it does not create new scheduling, claim or promotion authority.
